text:
Posted by Pete Kolinski 20 pm Green Brick Partners, Inc. (NASDAQ:GRBK) Ratings Coverage
Among 3 analysts covering Green Brick Partners ( NASDAQ:GRBK ), 1 have Buy rating, 0 Sell and 2 Hold. Therefore 33% are positive. Green Brick Partners had 5 analyst reports since July 23, 2018 according to SRatingsIntel. Citigroup upgraded Green Brick Partners, Inc. (NASDAQ:GRBK) on Thursday, August 9 to “Buy” rating. Citigroup maintained Green Brick Partners, Inc. (NASDAQ:GRBK) on Monday, July 23 with “Neutral” rating. The rating was maintained by Credit Suisse with “Neutral” on Tuesday, December 18. The stock increased 1.32% or $0.1 during the last trading session, reaching $7.67. About 116,288 shares traded. Green Brick Partners, Inc. (NASDAQ:GRBK) has declined 28.76% since January 5, 2018 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 28.76% the S&P500.
Green Brick Partners, Inc. engages in the homebuilding business in the United States. The company has market cap of $389.02 million. It operates through two divisions, Builder Operations and Land Development. It has a 13.07 P/E ratio. The firm is involved in the land acquisition and development, entitlements, design, construction, marketing, and sale of various residential projects, such as town, single family, and luxury homes in master planned communities; development of lots for public and large private builders; and land and construction financing business.
